unverified: Memorial Boulevard, America's Cup Avenue, and Thames Street should be checked against the posted signs. An untagged piece stays at the class default.

Untagged residential, living street, service, unclassified, and tertiary roads are assumed 25 mph. A tertiary road posted above the cap would show as legal until a sign or a DOT speed is added. Those roads are listed for a person to check. A posted sign still wins.

sources.label: Newport commercial low-speed vehicle statute (jitneys only)

enforcement.note: State law lets a registered low-speed vehicle use roads posted 35 mph or less. A golf cart is not that vehicle. Newport's separate jitney statute (31-19.5) is a commercial permit, not a golf cart ordinance. The RI DMV's September 2024 list of towns that sent a local LSV rule does not include Newport. No city prohibition ordinance was found.
